parent: None found; RXQ Compounding, LLC is its own parent
notes: Independent 503B outsourcing pharmacy in Athens, Ohio. Its own Form 5500 plan shows 16 participants in 2019 and 25 in 2023, and JobsOhio recorded 17 retained jobs on a Workforce Grant, so the company is far below 500. The company website rxqcompounding.com is now a parked domain and the only news hit is a 2018 story on a $7 million raise for the FDA-registered facility; no parent or acquisition was found.

parent: None in the grant year; Michigan Milk Producers Association (Novi, MI) from January 2022
notes: JobsOhio's July 2020 release calls Superior Dairy a Canton, Ohio fourth-generation family company and the largest independently owned dairy manufacturer in Ohio, with 313 jobs retained; the Form 5500 plan shows 270 participants in 2019. The sale to Michigan Milk Producers Association was announced December 6, 2021 and closed in January 2022, after the fiscal 2020 grant year, so the grant-year parent is LEL Operating Company itself.

parent: None; founder-owned, and itself the owner of Old Elk Distillery in Colorado
notes: JobsOhio's March 2023 release on the Alum Creek Drive plant lists 46 jobs retained and 80 committed for the Columbus distillery, and the 2023 Form 5500 shows 32 participants, so the company is well under 500 in every grant year. Founded in Columbus in 2008 by Brady Konya and Ryan Lang and still founder-led; it owns Old Elk Distillery rather than being owned by anyone.

parent: None found; privately held, with the LogistiQ brand in Port Clinton under the same ownership
notes: JobsOhio's December 2020 release records 168 jobs retained and 163 committed for the Ottawa County redevelopment and places the company in northwest Ohio, founded in Sandusky in 1917 as the Ohio Welding Company. Form 5500 participants went from 186 in 2019 to 369 in 2023, so the fiscal 2021 grant year sits well below 500. The company site lists three north central Ohio locations and no outside owner.

JobsOhio's August 2021 release states 900 or more jobs retained and 250 committed, and says the family-owned company conducts all significant functions, headquarters included, at Oberlin. The Form 5500 plan shows 844 participants in 2019 and 880 in 2023. Over 500 employees, and the home state is Ohio.

parent: Trew, LLC itself; American Industrial Partners held a stake from August 2023, and a fund is not the parent
notes: JobsOhio's April 2024 release puts Trew's headquarters and main plant in West Chester, Ohio with 220 jobs created to date and 190 more committed, and the 2023 Form 5500 shows 415 participants, a count that includes former employees. Adding the Guelph, Ontario plant still leaves the company under 500, but close enough to the line that this is a Medium call. American Industrial Partners combined Trew with Honeywell Intelligrated and Transnorm in July 2026, two years after the grant year.

parent: None found; privately held, Findlay, Ohio
notes: JobsOhio's April 2026 release confirms the Findlay headquarters, the 1988 founding and private ownership, and reports 35 locations in five states with 9 million square feet, but publishes no headcount. The company site, careers page and news page give none either, there is no Form 5500 plan, the Wayback Machine returned rate-limit errors, and news searches turned up no employment figure. Keeping the current Small call on the company's own 'over 400 associates' claim and a LinkedIn band of 201-500, but by the fiscal 2024 grant year the 500 line is genuinely open.

parent: Univar Solutions Inc., Downers Grove, IL; Apollo Funds took it private in August 2023, and a fund is not the parent
notes: The 2019 Form 10-K states approximately 10,300 employees on a full-time-equivalent basis worldwide, and SEC records give the business address as 3075 Highland Parkway, Downers Grove, Illinois. JobsOhio's 2019 release describes the Dublin, Ohio site as a shared-services center with 313 full-time employees, which is the Ohio plant, not the parent.

The company's own about page places the headquarters in Chagrin Falls, Ohio and lists four North American plants plus a Taizhou, China facility and a Shanghai sales office, with no parent, group or holding company named. Form 5500 participants were 510 in 2015, 521 in 2019 and 627 in 2023, counts that include former employees with balances, so active worldwide headcount in the 2017 and 2021 grant years most likely sat just under 500. Mar-Bal bought Lattice Composites in November 2020 and Lattice moved back out as a standalone entity in December 2024.

parent: None in the grant years; Oliver Inc. (Rochester, NY) from January 2023
notes: The Chilcote Company traded as Tap Packaging + Design in Cleveland and then Brooklyn, Ohio. Its own Form 5500 plan shows 436 participants in 2015, 315 in 2019 and 155 in 2023, and JobsOhio recorded 120 retained jobs for the 2020 grant, so it was well under 500 and Ohio-run in the 2020 and 2021 grant years. Oliver Inc. of Rochester, New York completed its acquisition of Tap Packaging in January 2023, after both grant years; chilcote.com and tappackaging.com are now dead.

parent: None found; privately held, founded by Bala Ramaiah
notes: JobsOhio's December 2020 release on the Solon data center and security operations center states the company is headquartered in the Greater Los Angeles area and ranked 892 on the Inc. 5000, which confirms the California home state and points to a company well short of 500 in the United States. Its Form 5500 plan grew from 36 participants in 2019 to 81 in 2023. Offices in India, the United Kingdom, Singapore and the Middle East leave worldwide headcount less certain, hence Medium. ISSQUARED acquired CCT Technologies in May 2024, after the 2022 grant year.

parent: M&M Industries, Inc., Chattanooga, TN; family-owned and led by Glenn Morris Jr.
notes: The Chattanooga Times Free Press reported 400 employees at the Chattanooga and Phoenix plants in November 2017, alongside a $42.7 million expansion projected to add 110 more jobs. The company then opened a Lordstown, Ohio plant in 2021 and broke ground on a doubling of it in November 2022, and its careers page lists Chattanooga, Lordstown and Phoenix. That puts the 2022 to 2024 grant years just above 500, though the parent's Form 5500 plan showed only 503 participants in 2023, so the call is Medium rather than High. The Ohio affiliate is the grantee; the parent's home state is Tennessee.

employees_estimate: over 7,500 in the automotive division alone
parent: KIRCHHOFF Group, Iserlohn, Germany; family-owned since 1785
notes: KIRCHHOFF Automotive's own company page reports roughly 7,600 employees worldwide across 29 locations in 10 countries, and its imprint gives the registered office as KIRCHHOFF Automotive SE, Stefanstrasse 2, D-58638 Iserlohn, Germany. A separate page states the family-owned business is part of the KIRCHHOFF Group alongside KIRCHHOFF Ecotec, KIRCHHOFF Mobility and WITTE Tools; the division was larger still in the 2021 and 2022 grant years. The Waverly, Ohio stamping plant with 230 retained jobs is a plant of that group, not the parent.

parent: NuVasive, Inc., San Diego, CA; Globus Medical (Audubon, PA) from September 2023
notes: The 2022 Form 10-K Human Capital section states approximately 3,000 employees worldwide as of December 31, 2022, with about 2,500 in the United States, and SEC records give the business address as San Diego, California. The West Carrollton plant, which JobsOhio credits with 97 retained jobs, is a subsidiary site. Globus Medical completed its acquisition of NuVasive in September 2023, inside the 2023 and 2024 grant years, but the parent is large and out of state either way.

parent: None found; Surgere, Inc. is its own parent
notes: JobsOhio's January 2020 release describes Surgere as founded in 2004, moving within northeast Ohio to the city of Green, with 52 jobs retained and 93 committed. Its own Form 5500 plan shows 43 participants in 2019 and 94 in 2023. Far below 500, headquartered in Ohio, and no parent or acquirer found.
